outcome: Admission to the Special Care Unit
cohort: 1455 women with PROM after 28 weeks of gestation and their newborns at Mulago Hospital
finding: Vaginal delivery for PROM after 28 weeks gestation in low-resource settings was not associated with higher perinatal mortality compared to caesarean delivery, and was associated with less maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with increased maternal postpartum infections, admission to the Special Care Unit and maternal death.
